newsitem.title: ITALY: Finmeccanica in Euroyen bond issue - Merrill.
newsitem.headline: Finmeccanica in Euroyen bond issue - Merrill.

text.p: Merrill Lynch said it has launched a series of non-secured Euro yen bond issues for Italian state controlled engineering group Finmeccanica.
In a statement received in Milan, Merrill said the total amount of the bonds was 40 billion yen, with maturities spanning between three and 10 years.
The issue follows a very successful roadshow by Finmeccanica in Japan, the statement added. It gave no further details.
Finmeccanica is Italy's largest defence and aerospace group and is controlled by state industrial holding IRI.
